title: Panels and layout: scrolling column, closing, End turn, redo bar
description: Alpha feedback batch W3. The player column scrolls clear of the action bar (desktop) and of the floating buttons (phone drawer, now with a Close button and tap-outside close); Pass and End turn sit right after the other action buttons; the turn redo bar can be hidden; the turn sound beeps once per run of decisions and has a labelled on/off button. Before shots are taken on main; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CF. Mocked fixtures.

shots.heading: Before: desktop column scrolled to the end
shots.caption: The last player sheet is cut off behind the action bar.

shots.heading: After: desktop column scrolled to the end
shots.caption: Extra room under the last sheet: it ends above the bar.

shots.heading: Before: phone drawer scrolled to the end
shots.caption: The last sheet sits under the floating Players / Objectives / Events buttons; no Close button.

shots.heading: After: phone drawer scrolled to the end
shots.caption: The last sheet clears the buttons; Close at the top, a tap outside closes too.

shots.heading: Before: action bar
shots.caption: Pass and End turn are pushed to the far edge of the bar.

shots.heading: After: action bar
shots.caption: Pass and End turn follow the other buttons, set off by a thin rule.

shots.heading: After: sound button
shots.caption: Labelled Sound on / Sound off. The run asserts one beep for the whole turn.

shots.heading: After: redo bar, desktop
shots.caption: A Hide button (not offered where Restore or Keep is the answer).

shots.heading: After: hidden, desktop
shots.caption: The bar is gone until the redo moves to another state.

notes.title: Closing
notes.text: Escape closes every panel already. Now a tap on the dimmed area outside the Objectives dialog or the action window closes (minimizes) it, and phone drawers close on a tap outside or their Close button; the feedback sheet already had all three.

notes.title: Movement with nothing to move
notes.text: Covered by vitest (useLoneAutoSubmit.test.tsx) and docs/AUTO_RESOLVE_CASES.md: a movement whose only option is done_moving is answered by the client and its dialog is not shown.
